spec.description:
Autex Bespoke Print Cube is a fully customisable acoustic wall and ceiling
panel that combines the acoustic performance of Cube solid polyester felt with
bespoke digital printing. High-resolution imagery, brand graphics, patterns, or
custom artwork are printed directly onto 12mm or 24mm Cube panels using safe,
water-based, UV-cured inks. It delivers an authentic, high-definition visual
finish with an NRC of 0.45 to 0.70 while maintaining Group 1 fire compliance and
carbon-neutral credentials.

install:
Review the Bespoke Print layout diagram
before handling or cutting panels

Clean and prepare the substrate ensuring it
is flat, dry, and dust-free

Acclimatise panels in the installation
environment for at least 24 hours prior to install

Handle with clean cloth
gloves to prevent soiling the printed decorative surface

Use a sharp utility
knife and straight edge on the offcut side when trimming

Apply construction
adhesive evenly across the panel back or use SpinFix mounting hardware

Align
printed pattern or imagery seams carefully across adjacent panels

Press
firmly with a clean roller across the surface to secure adhesive contact
selection_checklist:
Provide high-resolution artwork (minimum 300 DPI
at 1:1 scale or vector format)

Confirm panel thickness (12mm for standard
wall art vs 24mm for higher NRC 0.70 absorption)

Confirm total wall
dimensions and required panel seam alignments

Choose mounting system (direct
adhesive fix vs SpinFix demountable fixings)

Ensure area is non-contact or
low-impact to protect print quality
accessories: Autex Edging Solutions (Type B for 12mm, Type C for 24mm)
limitations:
Printed face can show scuffing or
surface damage if subjected to hard mechanical contact

Not recommended for
high-impact sports zones or heavy corridor traffic without protection

Ensure
high-resolution artwork meets Autex print guidelines to prevent pixelation

retrieval.rag_summary:
Autex Bespoke Print
Cube transforms Autex's flagship 12mm and 24mm solid polyester Cube panels into
custom printed acoustic artwork. Using safe, water-based UV-cured inks, custom
photography, murals, and corporate branding are printed directly onto the
compressed PET felt without hindering its sound absorption capabilities
(NRC 0.45 to 0.70). Featuring a Group 1 fire classification, carbon-neutral
manufacturing, and minimum 80% recycled content, it provides an architecturally
striking solution to unwanted reverberation in commercial and institutional
interiors.
